## Usage

```tsx
import { Composition } from "remotion";
import {
  DEFAULT_INTRODUCING_PRODUCT_PROPS,
  getIntroducingProductDuration,
  IntroducingProduct,
  introducingProductSchema,
} from "@/components/remocn/templates/introducing-product";

export const RemotionRoot = () => (
  <Composition
    id="IntroducingProduct"
    component={IntroducingProduct}
    schema={introducingProductSchema}
    durationInFrames={1596}
    fps={30}
    width={1280}
    height={720}
    calculateMetadata={({props}) => ({
      durationInFrames: getIntroducingProductDuration(props.timeline),
    })}
    defaultProps={DEFAULT_INTRODUCING_PRODUCT_PROPS}
  />
);
```

The template renders entirely from its built-in mock product UI. Set
`content.logoUrl` and `content.screenshotUrls` to replace the generated brand
mark and UI panels with real product assets.

## Edit in Remotion Studio

This repository includes a permanent Studio entry with all defaults written
inline, so changes can be saved back to code:

```bash
bunx remotion studio src/remotion/introducing-product-root.tsx
```

Open the **Props** panel and edit the nested groups. `timeline` controls the
duration of every scene, while each entry in `scenes` exposes its position,
size, internal transition points, and easing preset. The total composition
duration updates automatically.
